description.narrative: This Activity responds to requests from the Government of Tonga for New Zealand and Australian to build a new Fale Alea (Parliament House) and Office of the Legislative Assembly (OLA). Tropical Cyclone Gita in February 2018 destroyed the previous Fale Alea which resulted in the OLA building being condemned.
